python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

program_id = os.environ["RAW_PROGRAM_ID"].strip()

if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9-]{2,63}", program_id):
    raise SystemExit("PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL invalid identifier syntax")

files = []

root = Path("bubbleverse_program_registry.json")
if root.is_file():
    files.append(root)

files.extend(sorted(Path(".").glob("bubbleverse_program_registry_*.json")))

if not files:
    raise SystemExit("REGISTRY_GATE=FAIL no registry files found")

matches = []

for path in files:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    programs = data.get("programs", {})

    if program_id in programs:
        matches.append((path, programs[program_id]))

if not matches:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL exact registry match not found id={program_id}"
    )

if len(matches) != 1:
    where = ",".join(str(p) for p, _ in matches)
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL duplicate registry definitions id={program_id} files={where}"
    )

source_file, entry = matches[0]

if entry.get("status") != "ACTIVE":
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL status={entry.get('status')}"
    )

q = entry.get("q", "")
workflow_id = entry.get("workflow_id", "")
target_ref = entry.get("target_ref", "main")

if not re.fullmatch(r"Q-[0-9]{3,}", q):
    raise SystemExit("Q_IDENTITY_GATE=FAIL registry q invalid")

if (
    not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.ya?ml", workflow_id)
    or "/" in workflow_id
    or "\\" in workflow_id
):
    raise SystemExit("LAUNCHER_GATE=FAIL unsafe workflow id")

if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+", target_ref) or ".." in target_ref:
    raise SystemExit("LAUNCHER_GATE=FAIL unsafe target ref")

out = os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"]

with open(out, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(f"program_id={program_id}\n")
    f.write(f"q={q}\n")
    f.write(f"workflow_id={workflow_id}\n")
    f.write(f"target_ref={target_ref}\n")

print(f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=PASS program_id={program_id}")
print(f"REGISTRY_SOURCE={source_file}")
print(f"Q_IDENTITY_GATE=PASS q={q}")
print(f"LAUNCHER_GATE=PASS workflow_id={workflow_id}")
PY

)

if not matches:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL exact registry match not found id={program_id}"
    )

if len(matches) != 1:
    locations = ",".join(str(path) for path, _ in matches)
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL duplicate definitions id={program_id} files={locations}"
    )

source_file, entry = matches[0]

if entry.get("status") != "ACTIVE":
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL status={entry.get('status')}"
    )

q = str(entry.get("q", ""))
workflow_id = str(entry.get("workflow_id", ""))

    or "/" in workflow_id
    or "\\" in workflow_id
):

expected = entry.get("result_artifacts")

if expected is None:

):

  gh api               "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/${WORKFLOW_ID}/runs?event=workflow_dispatch&per_page=100"               --jq '.workflow_runs[].id'               | sort -n               > /tmp/bubbleverse_after_child_runs.txt

  child_id="$(
    comm -13                 /tmp/bubbleverse_before_child_runs.txt                 /tmp/bubbleverse_after_child_runs.txt               | tail -n 1
  )"

  if [[ -n "$child_id" ]]; then
    break
  fi

  sleep 2
done

if [[ -z "$child_id" ]]; then
  echo "CHILD_DISCOVERY_GATE=FAIL no new child workflow run found"
  exit 4
fi

child_url="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${child_id}"

echo "child_run_id=$child_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "child_url=$child_url" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

echo "CHILD_DISCOVERY_GATE=PASS child_run_id=$child_id"
echo "CHILD_URL=$child_url"

set -euo pipefail

if [[ -z "$CHILD_RUN_ID" ]]; then
  echo "WATCH_GATE=FAIL missing child run id"
  exit 2
fi

check_child() {
  gh api               "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${CHILD_RUN_ID}"               --jq '[.status, (.conclusion // "")] | @tsv'
}

state="$(check_child)"
status="${state%%$'\t'*}"
conclusion="${state#*$'\t'}"

echo "WATCH_SEGMENT=$SEGMENT initial_status=$status conclusion=$conclusion"
echo "CHILD_URL=$CHILD_URL"

if [[ "$status" == "completed" ]]; then
  echo "WATCH_SEGMENT=$SEGMENT CHILD_ALREADY_COMPLETED conclusion=$conclusion"
  exit 0
fi

# About 5 hours per segment. Job timeout is 5h30m,
# leaving margin below GitHub's 6-hour hosted-job ceiling.
for poll in $(seq 1 300); do
  sleep 60

  state="$(check_child)"
  status="${state%%$'\t'*}"
  conclusion="${state#*$'\t'}"

  if (( poll % 10 == 0 )); then
    echo "WATCH_SEGMENT=$SEGMENT poll=$poll status=$status"
  fi

  if [[ "$status" == "completed" ]]; then
    echo "WATCH_SEGMENT=$SEGMENT CHILD_COMPLETED conclusion=$conclusion"
    exit 0
  fi
done

echo "WATCH_SEGMENT=$SEGMENT COMPLETE child_still_running status=$status"
exit 0

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

run = json.loads(os.environ["RUN_JSON"])
pages = json.loads(os.environ["ARTIFACTS_PAGES"])
expected = json.loads(os.environ["EXPECTED_ARTIFACTS_JSON"])

artifacts = []
for page in pages:
    artifacts.extend(page.get("artifacts", []))

actual = sorted(
    {
        str(a.get("name"))
        for a in artifacts
        if not a.get("expired", False)
    }
)

missing = sorted(set(expected) - set(actual))

child_status = str(run.get("status") or "")
child_conclusion = str(run.get("conclusion") or "")

contract_ok = (
    child_status == "completed"
    and child_conclusion == "success"
    and not missing
)

mirror_names = actual if actual else ["__NO_CHILD_ARTIFACTS__"]

report = {
    "schema": "BUBBLEVERSE_SEGMENTED_START_REPORT_V1",
    "program_id": os.environ["PROGRAM_ID"],
    "q": os.environ["Q_ID"],
    "repository": os.environ["GITHUB_REPOSITORY"],
    "launcher_run_id": os.environ["GITHUB_RUN_ID"],
    "child_run_id": int(os.environ["CHILD_RUN_ID"]),
    "child_url": os.environ["CHILD_URL"],
    "child_status": child_status,
    "child_conclusion": child_conclusion,
    "expected_artifacts": expected,
    "actual_artifacts": actual,
    "missing_artifacts": missing,
    "artifact_contract_ok": contract_ok,
    "watch_segments": 12,
    "watch_segment_minutes": 300,
    "watch_horizon_hours": 60,
    "monitor_horizon_exceeded": child_status != "completed",
}

Path("bubbleverse_start_report/bubbleverse_segmented_start_report.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)

with open(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(f"child_status={child_status}\n")
    f.write(f"child_conclusion={child_conclusion}\n")
    f.write(f"contract_ok={'true' if contract_ok else 'false'}\n")
    f.write(
        "actual_artifacts_json="
        + json.dumps(actual, separators=(",", ":"))
        + "\n"
    )
    f.write(
        "missing_artifacts_json="
        + json.dumps(missing, separators=(",", ":"))
        + "\n"
    )
    f.write(

    raise SystemExit("PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL invalid identifier syntax")

    registry_files.append(master)

    p for p in sorted(Path(".").glob("bubbleverse_program_registry_*.json"))
    if p != master
)

if not registry_files:
    raise SystemExit("REGISTRY_GATE=FAIL no registry files found")

matches = []

for path in registry_files:
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    programs = data.get("programs", {})

    if program_id in programs:
        matches.append((path, programs[program_id]))

if not matches:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL exact registry match not found id={program_id}"
    )

if len(matches) != 1:
    locations = ",".join(str(path) for path, _ in matches)
    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL duplicate definitions id={program_id} files={locations}"
    )

source_file, entry = matches[0]

    raise SystemExit(
        f"PROGRAM_ID_GATE=FAIL status={entry.get('status')}"
    )

q = str(entry.get("q", ""))
workflow_id = str(entry.get("workflow_id", ""))
target_ref = str(entry.get("target_ref", "main"))

    expected = [one] if isinstance(one, str) and one else []

if not isinstance(expected, list) or not all(
    isinstance(x, str) and x for x in expected
):

workflow_runs.step: Acquire frozen Q005 V14 baseline by identity
workflow_runs.run:
set -euo pipefail
rm -rf q009_v5_parent/q005 q009_v5_q005_scan
mkdir -p q009_v5_parent/q005 q009_v5_q005_scan

mapfile -t RUN_IDS < <(
  gh run list \
    --workflow q005-hpc-v14.yml \
    --status completed \
    --limit 100 \
    --json databaseId \
    --jq '.[].databaseId'
)

FOUND_RUN=""
for RUN_ID in "${RUN_IDS[@]}"; do
  rm -rf q009_v5_q005_scan/current
  mkdir -p q009_v5_q005_scan/current

  if ! gh run download "$RUN_ID" \
    --name q005-v14-final-result \
    --dir q009_v5_q005_scan/current >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    continue
  fi

  CANDIDATE="q009_v5_q005_scan/current/q005_hpc_v14_final_result.json"
  if [[ ! -f "$CANDIDATE" ]]; then
    continue
  fi

  if CANDIDATE="$CANDIDATE" EXPECTED_H0="$EXPECTED_H0" EXPECTED_CHI2="$EXPECTED_CHI2" python - <<'PY'
import json, math, os, sys

p=os.environ["CANDIDATE"]
expected_h0=float(os.environ["EXPECTED_H0"])
expected_chi2=float(os.environ["EXPECTED_CHI2"])

try:
    d=json.load(open(p))
    rec=d["models"]["ede_n3"]
    h0=float(rec["bestfit"]["H0"])
    chi2=float(rec["chi2_scientific_total"])
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)

ok=(
    d.get("q")=="Q-005"
    and math.isclose(h0, expected_h0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-6)
    and math.isclose(chi2, expected_chi2, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-3)
)
if not ok:
    sys.exit(1)

print(f"Q005_BASELINE_IDENTITY_MATCH H0={h0} chi2={chi2}")
PY
  then
    cp "$CANDIDATE" q009_v5_parent/q005/q005_hpc_v14_final_result.json
    FOUND_RUN="$RUN_ID"
    break
  fi
done

if [[ -z "$FOUND_RUN" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Q005_BASELINE_ARTIFACT_GATE=FAIL no retained q005-v14-final-result with H0=70.853292 and chi2=548.010401 found in last 100 completed Q005 runs"

gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/33732688762" > /tmp/q016_v6_run.json
gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/33732688762/artifacts?per_page=100" > /tmp/q016_v6_artifacts.json
mkdir -p q016_parent_v6
gh run download "33732688762" --name q016-primary-merged-v6 --dir q016_parent_v6
python - <<'PY'
import json,math
run=json.load(open('/tmp/q016_v6_run.json'))
assert run['head_sha']=='d14880138ebb537173e49417b537a68454d53602'
arts=json.load(open('/tmp/q016_v6_artifacts.json'))['artifacts']
a=[x for x in arts if x['name']=='q016-primary-merged-v6']
assert len(a)==1 and int(a[0]['id'])==9888806606
assert a[0]['digest']=='sha256:6fb8ff7693c955516bf3a1a0e0c066876aa39c1f377d720b8b7bf6ed8a0f6aab'
p='q016_parent_v6/q016_primary_merged_v6.json'
d=json.load(open(p)); lock=json.load(open('q016_v6_objective_seed_lock_v9.json'))
assert d['q']=='Q016' and d['run_id']=='Q016-MATCHED-CMB-SURFACE-V6'
def obj(branch,row):
    x=float(row['chi2'])+((float(row['tau_reio'])-.051)/.006)**2
    if branch=='planck':
        x+=((float(row['A_planck'])-1)/.0025)**2
        x+=((float(row['calTE'])-1)/.01)**2
        x+=((float(row['calEE'])-1)/.01)**2
    if branch=='spt':x+=((float(row['Tcal'])-1)/.0036)**2
    return x
for b in ('planck','spt','act'):
    for m in ('reference_free_h0','fixed_h0_71p5'):
        vals=[(obj(b,r['minimum']),r) for r in d['branches'][b]['profiles'][m]['all']]
        vals.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
        L=lock['profiles'][b][m]
        assert abs(vals[0][0]-float(L['objective_best_from_v6_history']))<1e-9
        assert vals[0][1]['run_id']==L['source_run_id']
        assert int(vals[0][1]['restart'])==int(L['source_restart'])
print('Q016_V9_V6_PARENT_SEED_LOCK_GATE=PASS')
PY

python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('q022_parent')
expected = {(m, s) for m in (3, 6, 7) for s in (0, 1, 2)}

def collect(subdir, phase):
    found = {}
    for p in (root/subdir).rglob('*.json'):
        d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        if (d.get('q') == 'Q022' and
            d.get('run_id') == 'Q022-FULL-MF-OPTIMIZER-BASIN-CONTINUATION-V2' and
            d.get('result_id') == 'R-Q022-EDE-FULLMF-OPTIMIZER-BASIN-002' and
            d.get('stage') == 'Q022_CROSS_START_CONTINUATION' and
            d.get('phase') == phase and
            d.get('status') == 'COMPLETE'):
            key = (int(d['mask']), int(d['seed_restart']))
            if key in found:
                raise SystemExit(f'Q022_{phase.upper()}_DUPLICATE_GATE=FAIL key={key}')
            found[key] = str(p)
    if set(found) != expected:
        missing = sorted(expected - set(found))
        extra = sorted(set(found) - expected)
        raise SystemExit(
            f'Q022_{phase.upper()}_COMPLETENESS_GATE=FAIL '
            f'count={len(found)} missing={missing} extra={extra}'
        )
    print(f'Q022_{phase.upper()}_COMPLETENESS_GATE=PASS count={len(found)}')

collect('stage1', 'stage1')
collect('refinement', 'refinement')

finals = list((root/'final').rglob('q022_final_v2.json'))
if len(finals) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'Q022_FINAL_ARTIFACT_GATE=FAIL hits={len(finals)} files={finals}')
f = json.loads(finals[0].read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert f.get('q') == 'Q022'
assert f.get('FINAL_RESULT_GATE') == 'PASS'
assert f.get('status') == 'PASS'
print('Q022_FINAL_ARTIFACT_GATE=PASS')
print('Q022_PHASE_ISOLATION_GATE=PASS')
PY

entries.working_directory: Any directory with gh; jobs execute in their own checkout
prerequisites: All setup, downloaded artifacts, frozen inputs, runner software and environment in this workflow
entries.configuration: Read canonical workflow; exact job commands are in start_catalog.json

workflow_runs.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "${{ inputs.program_id || 'Q040-RQMC-V3' }}" = "$PROGRAM_ID"
test "$CURRENT_Q" = 'Q-040'
test -f q040_defensive_rqmc_v3.py
test -f q040_defensive_rqmc_tests_v3.py
test -f q040_defensive_rqmc_preregister_v3.json
test -f q040_defensive_rqmc_source_lock_v3.json
test -f q040_cmbspace_coupled_bridge_v2.py
test -f q039_prepare_frozen_env_v4.sh
test -f .github/workflows/q040-defensive-rqmc-v3.yml
test -f .github/workflows/00-bubbleverse-start.yml
python - <<'PY2'
import json
from pathlib import Path
d=json.loads(Path('bubbleverse_program_registry.json').read_text())
e=d.get('programs',{}).get('Q040-RQMC-V3')
assert e and e.get('status')=='ACTIVE',e
assert e.get('q')=='Q-040',e
assert e.get('workflow_id')=='q040-defensive-rqmc-v3.yml',e
assert e.get('workflow_path')=='.github/workflows/q040-defensive-rqmc-v3.yml',e
launcher=Path('.github/workflows/00-bubbleverse-start.yml').read_text()
assert 'exact registry match not found' in launcher
assert 'gh workflow run "$WORKFLOW_ID"' in launcher
assert 'eval' not in launcher.lower()
print('Q040_RQMC_REGISTRY_LAUNCHER_GATE=PASS')
PY2
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.15.3 PyYAML==6.0.2

python -m py_compile q040_defensive_rqmc_v3.py q040_defensive_rqmc_tests_v3.py
python q040_defensive_rqmc_tests_v3.py static \
  --program q040_defensive_rqmc_v3.py \
  --preregister q040_defensive_rqmc_preregister_v3.json \
  --source-lock q040_defensive_rqmc_source_lock_v3.json \
  --workflow .github/workflows/q040-defensive-rqmc-v3.yml \
  --output q040_rqmc_static_tests_v3.json
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.15.3 PyYAML==6.0.2
python q040_defensive_rqmc_v3.py validate-parent --parent-dir q032_parent_profiles --output q040_rqmc_parent_gate_v3.json

set -euo pipefail
git cat-file -e "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT^{commit}"
git worktree add --detach q032_parent "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
test "$(git -C q032_parent rev-parse HEAD)" = "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
test '${{ steps.q032cache.outputs.cache-hit }}' = 'true'
bash q039_prepare_frozen_env_v4.sh 'both'

set -euo pipefail

workflow_runs.step: Reject incomplete execution chain as technical, never numerical science failure
workflow_runs.run:
python - <<'PY3'
import json, os
d=json.loads(os.environ['NEEDS_JSON'])
bad={k:v.get('result') for k,v in d.items() if v.get('result') in ('failure','cancelled')}
if bad:
    raise SystemExit('RQMC_UPSTREAM_EXECUTION_GATE=FAIL '+json.dumps(bad,sort_keys=True))
print('RQMC_UPSTREAM_EXECUTION_GATE=PASS')
PY3

python q040_defensive_rqmc_v3.py integration-gate \
  --state-dir q040_states \
  --output q040_rqmc_integration_gate_v3.json \
  --selected-output q040_rqmc_integration_selected_v3.json
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check numpy==1.26.4 scipy==1.15.3 PyYAML==6.0.2

python q040_defensive_rqmc_v3.py seal-failure \
  --gate q040_gate/q040_rqmc_integration_gate_v3.json \
  --preregister q040_defensive_rqmc_preregister_v3.json --source-lock q040_defensive_rqmc_source_lock_v3.json \
  --output q040_final_v3.json --handoff q040_return_handoff_v3.json

set -euo pipefail
git cat-file -e "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT^{commit}"
git worktree add --detach q032_parent "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"

  --max-segments "$MAX_SEGMENTS" \
  --output-dir q041_chain

python - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
arms=("camspec","hillipop")
combos=("P","P_A6","P_L6","P_D2","P_A6_L6_D2","P_L6_D2","P_A6_D2","P_A6_L6")
expected={(a,c,k) for a in arms for c in combos for k in (0,1)}
rows={}
for p in pathlib.Path("q041_segment_artifacts").rglob("q041_chain_metadata_v14.json"):
    try:
        d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        continue
    if d.get("q")!="Q-041" or d.get("program_id")!="Q041-PLANCKPORT-V14":
        continue
    key=(d.get("implementation"),d.get("combo"),int(d.get("chain",-1)))
    rows[key]=d
missing=sorted(expected-set(rows))
failed=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="FAILED")
complete=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="COMPLETE" and d.get("actual_computed_result") is True)
partial=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="PARTIAL_SOFT_STOP")
unknown=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status") not in ("COMPLETE","PARTIAL_SOFT_STOP","FAILED"))
seg=int(os.environ["SEGMENT"])
maxseg=int(os.environ.get("MAX_SEGMENTS","8"))
summary={
    "q":"Q-041","program_id":"Q041-PLANCKPORT-V14","stage":"SEGMENT_DECISION",
    "segment":seg,"expected":len(expected),"complete":len(complete),"partial":len(partial),
    "failed":len(failed),"missing":len(missing),"unknown":len(unknown),
    "failed_keys":failed,"missing_keys":missing,"unknown_keys":unknown,
}
pathlib.Path("q041_segment_decision_v14.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8"
)
out=pathlib.Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"])
if missing or failed or unknown:
    with out.open("a") as f:
        f.write("all_complete=false\nfatal=true\nnext_segment=0\n")
    raise SystemExit(
        "Q041_SEGMENT_DECISION_GATE=FAIL "
        f"missing={len(missing)} failed={len(failed)} unknown={len(unknown)}"
    )
if len(complete)==len(expected):
    with out.open("a") as f:
        f.write("all_complete=true\nfatal=false\nnext_segment=0\n")
    print("Q041_SEGMENT_DECISION_GATE=ALL_COMPLETE")
elif seg >= maxseg:
    with out.open("a") as f:
        f.write("all_complete=false\nfatal=true\nnext_segment=0\n")
    raise SystemExit(
        f"Q041_SEGMENT_BUDGET_GATE=FAIL segment={seg} partial={len(partial)}"
    )

workflow_runs.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
arms=("camspec","hillipop")
combos=("P","P_A6","P_L6","P_D2","P_A6_L6_D2","P_L6_D2","P_A6_D2","P_A6_L6")
expected={(a,c,k) for a in arms for c in combos for k in (0,1)}; rows={}
for p in pathlib.Path("q041_segment_artifacts").rglob("q041_chain_metadata_v17.json"):
    try: d=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception: continue
    if d.get("q")!="Q-041" or d.get("program_id")!="Q041-PLANCKPORT-V17": continue
    rows[(d.get("implementation"),d.get("combo"),int(d.get("chain",-1)))]=d
missing=sorted(expected-set(rows)); failed=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="FAILED")
complete=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="COMPLETE" and d.get("actual_computed_result") is True)
partial=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="PARTIAL_SOFT_STOP")
no_science=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status")=="NO_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT")
known={"COMPLETE","PARTIAL_SOFT_STOP","NO_SCIENTIFIC_RESULT","FAILED"}
unknown=sorted(k for k,d in rows.items() if d.get("status") not in known)
seg=int(os.environ["SEGMENT"]); maxseg=int(os.environ.get("MAX_SEGMENTS","8")); reason=None
if no_science:
    reasons={rows[k].get("no_science_reason") for k in no_science}
    if reasons!={"MAX_SAMPLES_WITHOUT_CONVERGENCE"}: raise SystemExit(f"Q041_CONTROLLED_REASON_GATE=FAIL reasons={sorted(map(str,reasons))}")
    reason="MAX_SAMPLES_WITHOUT_CONVERGENCE"
elif partial:
    exhausted=[k for k in partial if int(rows[k].get("compute_segments_used",0) or 0)>=maxseg]
    if exhausted:
        reason="SEGMENT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED_WITH_UNCONVERGED_CHAINS"
technical=bool(missing or failed or unknown)
summary={"q":"Q-041","program_id":"Q041-PLANCKPORT-V17","stage":"SEGMENT_DECISION","segment":seg,
         "expected":len(expected),"complete":len(complete),"partial":len(partial),"no_science":len(no_science),
         "failed":len(failed),"missing":len(missing),"unknown":len(unknown),"failed_keys":failed,"missing_keys":missing,
         "unknown_keys":unknown,"no_science_keys":no_science,"partial_keys":partial,
         "compute_segments_used":{"|".join(map(str,k)):rows[k].get("compute_segments_used") for k in sorted(rows)},
         "controlled_no_science":bool(reason),"no_science_reason":reason,"technical_failure":technical}
pathlib.Path("q041_segment_decision_v17.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
out=pathlib.Path(os.environ["GITHUB_OUTPUT"])
if technical:
    with out.open("a") as f: f.write("all_complete=false\nfatal=true\ncontrolled_no_science=false\nnext_segment=0\nno_science_reason=\n")
    raise SystemExit(f"Q041_SEGMENT_DECISION_TECHNICAL_GATE=FAIL missing={len(missing)} failed={len(failed)} unknown={len(unknown)}")
if reason:
    with out.open("a") as f: f.write(f"all_complete=false\nfatal=false\ncontrolled_no_science=true\nnext_segment=0\nno_science_reason={reason}\n")
    print(f"Q041_SEGMENT_DECISION_GATE=CONTROLLED_NO_SCIENCE reason={reason}")
elif len(complete)==len(expected):
    with out.open("a") as f: f.write("all_complete=true\nfatal=false\ncontrolled_no_science=false\nnext_segment=0\nno_science_reason=\n")
    print("Q041_SEGMENT_DECISION_GATE=ALL_COMPLETE")
else:
    nxt=seg+1
    if nxt>maxseg:
        with out.open("a") as f: f.write("all_complete=false\nfatal=true\ncontrolled_no_science=false\nnext_segment=0\nno_science_reason=\n")
        raise SystemExit("Q041_V17_ROUND_BUDGET_INVARIANT_GATE=FAIL")
    with out.open("a") as f: f.write(f"all_complete=false\nfatal=false\ncontrolled_no_science=false\nnext_segment={nxt}\nno_science_reason=\n")
    print(f"Q041_SEGMENT_DECISION_GATE=CONTINUE segment={seg} next={nxt} complete={len(complete)} partial={len(partial)}")
PY

entries.working_directory: Any directory with gh; jobs execute in their own checkout
prerequisites: All setup, downloaded artifacts, frozen inputs, runner software and environment in this workflow
entries.configuration: Read canonical workflow; exact job commands are in start_catalog.json

workflow_runs.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$INPUT_PROGRAM_ID" = "$PROGRAM_ID"
echo "PROGRAM_ID_GATE=PASS program_id=$PROGRAM_ID"
echo "Q_IDENTITY_GATE=PASS q=$CURRENT_Q"
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check numpy==1.26.4

python -m py_compile q042_execution_mechanism_v1.py q042_execution_mechanism_tests_v1.py
python - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
p='q042_execution_mechanism_preregister_v1.json'
l=json.load(open('q042_execution_mechanism_source_lock_v1.json'))
h=hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
assert l['preregister_sha256']==h
assert l['github_mutation'].startswith('FORBIDDEN')
assert l['external']['supernova']['component']=='sn.pantheonplus'
print('Q042_STATIC_GATE=PASS')
PY

workflow_runs.step: Download immutable V19 final-segment chain artifacts
workflow_runs.run:
set -euo pipefail
rm -rf q041_v19_seg8
mkdir -p q041_v19_seg8
gh run download "$V19_RUN_ID" \
  --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --pattern 'q041-chain-*-seg8-v19' \
  --dir q041_v19_seg8
test "$(find q041_v19_seg8 -name q041_chain_metadata_v19.json -type f | wc -l)" -eq 32
echo 'Q042_V19_ARTIFACT_DOWNLOAD_GATE=PASS count=32'

workflow_runs.step: Diagnose V19 and select execution mechanism
workflow_runs.run:
python q042_execution_mechanism_v1.py diagnose \
  --artifacts-dir q041_v19_seg8 \
  --preregister q042_execution_mechanism_preregister_v1.json \
  --source-lock q042_execution_mechanism_source_lock_v1.json \
  --output q042_execution_mechanism_result_v1.json

python q042_execution_mechanism_tests_v1.py \
  --result q042_execution_mechanism_result_v1.json \
  --reference q042_v19_diagnostic_reference_v1.json \
  --output q042_execution_mechanism_tests_result_v1.json

workflow_runs.run: bash q042_prepare_frozen_core_v4.sh both

mkdir -p q042_environment
python q042_planck_portability_v10.py prepare-nonoverlap \
  --q032-parent-root q032_parent \
  --preflight q032_preflight/q032_preflight_sealed_v2.json \
  --hlp-matrix q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.npy \
  --hlp-meta q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.json \
  --support-output q042_environment/q042_primary_nonoverlap_support_v10.json \
  --matrix-output q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v10.npy \
  --meta-output q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v10.json

  --q032-parent-root q032_parent \
  --preflight q032_preflight/q032_preflight_sealed_v2.json \
  --parent-dir q032_parent_profiles \
  --hlp-matrix q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.npy \
  --hlp-meta q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.json \
  --reduced-support q042_environment/q042_primary_nonoverlap_support_v10.json \
  --reduced-hlp-matrix q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v10.npy \
  --reduced-hlp-meta q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v10.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v10.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v10.json \
  --external-runtime q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v10.json \
  --output q042_environment/q042_runtime_preflight_v10.json

sudo apt-get update -y
sudo apt-get install -y gfortran gcc g++ make openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev pkg-config
command -v mpicc
command -v mpifort
mpirun --version | head -1

git fetch --depth 1 origin "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
rm -rf q032_parent
git worktree add --detach q032_parent "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"

workflow_runs.step: Recreate frozen core and assert Q042 runtime
workflow_runs.run:
bash q042_prepare_frozen_core_v4.sh both
bash q042_setup_v10.sh

python - <<'PY'
import json
a=json.load(open('q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v10.json'))
b=json.load(open('q042_environment_artifact/q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v10.json'))
assert a['polychord_commit']==b['polychord_commit'], 'POLYCHORD_CROSS_JOB_COMMIT_GATE=FAIL'
assert a['pantheonplus_manifest_sha256']==b['pantheonplus_manifest_sha256'], 'PANTHEONPLUS_CROSS_JOB_HASH_GATE=FAIL'
assert a['cobaya_version']==b['cobaya_version']=='3.5.6'
assert a['pybobyqa_version']==b['pybobyqa_version']=='1.5.0'
print('Q042_CROSS_JOB_SOURCE_IDENTITY_GATE=PASS')
PY

workflow_runs.step: Run process-isolated bounded FULL PolyChord + external BOBYQA pilot
workflow_runs.run:
python q042_planck_portability_v10.py pilot-cell \
  --q032-parent-root q032_parent \
  --preflight q032_preflight/q032_preflight_sealed_v2.json \
  --parent-dir q032_parent_profiles \
  --hlp-matrix q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.npy \
  --hlp-meta q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.json \
  --reduced-support q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_primary_nonoverlap_support_v10.json \
  --reduced-hlp-matrix q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v10.npy \
  --reduced-hlp-meta q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v10.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v10.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v10.json \
  --external-runtime q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v10.json \
  --arm ${{ matrix.arm }} \
  --model ${{ matrix.model }} \
  --output-dir q042_pilot_${{ matrix.id }}

python q042_planck_portability_v10.py merge-pilots \
  --input-dir q042_pilots \
  --environment-preflight q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_runtime_preflight_v10.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v10.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v10.json \
  --output q042_preflight_final_v10.json
python q042_planck_portability_tests_v10.py final \
  --result q042_preflight_final_v10.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v10.json \
  --output q042_preflight_tests_v10.json

commands: gh workflow run q042-planck-portability-v3.yml --repo Morfindien/Bubbleverse --ref main -f "program_id=${PROGRAM_ID_REQUIRED}"
entries.working_directory: Any directory with gh; jobs execute in their own checkout
prerequisites: All setup, downloaded artifacts, frozen inputs, runner software and environment in this workflow
entries.configuration: Read canonical workflow; exact job commands are in start_catalog.json

workflow_runs.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$INPUT_PROGRAM_ID" = "$PROGRAM_ID"
echo "PROGRAM_ID_GATE=PASS program_id=$PROGRAM_ID"
echo "Q_IDENTITY_GATE=PASS q=$CURRENT_Q"
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check PyYAML==6.0.2 numpy==1.26.4

python -m py_compile q042_planck_portability_v3.py q042_planck_portability_tests_v3.py
python q042_planck_portability_v3.py static \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v3.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v3.json \
  --output q042_static_program_v3.json
python q042_planck_portability_tests_v3.py static \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v3.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v3.json \
  --program q042_planck_portability_v3.py \
  --workflow .github/workflows/q042-planck-portability-v3.yml \
  --registry-patch q042_program_registry_patch_v3.json \
  --output q042_static_tests_v3.json

sudo apt-get update -y
sudo apt-get install -y gfortran gcc g++ make openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev pkg-config
command -v mpicc
command -v mpifort
mpirun --version | head -1

git fetch --depth 1 origin "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
rm -rf q032_parent
git worktree add --detach q032_parent "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
test "$(git -C q032_parent rev-parse HEAD)" = "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
bash q041_prepare_frozen_core_v19.sh both
bash q042_setup_v3.sh

mkdir -p q042_environment
python q042_planck_portability_v3.py prepare-nonoverlap \
  --q032-parent-root q032_parent \
  --preflight q032_preflight/q032_preflight_sealed_v2.json \
  --hlp-matrix q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.npy \
  --hlp-meta q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.json \
  --support-output q042_environment/q042_primary_nonoverlap_support_v3.json \
  --matrix-output q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v3.npy \
  --meta-output q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v3.json

workflow_runs.step: Build all 20 cells and evaluate all four FULL cells once
workflow_runs.run:
python q042_planck_portability_v3.py runtime-preflight \
  --q032-parent-root q032_parent \
  --preflight q032_preflight/q032_preflight_sealed_v2.json \
  --parent-dir q032_parent_profiles \
  --hlp-matrix q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.npy \
  --hlp-meta q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.json \
  --reduced-support q042_environment/q042_primary_nonoverlap_support_v3.json \
  --reduced-hlp-matrix q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v3.npy \
  --reduced-hlp-meta q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v3.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v3.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v3.json \
  --external-runtime q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v3.json \
  --output q042_environment/q042_runtime_preflight_v3.json

sudo apt-get update -y
sudo apt-get install -y gfortran gcc g++ make openmpi-bin libopenmpi-dev pkg-config
command -v mpicc
command -v mpifort
mpirun --version | head -1

git fetch --depth 1 origin "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"
rm -rf q032_parent
git worktree add --detach q032_parent "$Q032_EXECUTION_COMMIT"

workflow_runs.step: Recreate frozen core and assert Q042 runtime
workflow_runs.run:
bash q041_prepare_frozen_core_v19.sh both
bash q042_setup_v3.sh

python - <<'PY'
import json
a=json.load(open('q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v3.json'))
b=json.load(open('q042_environment_artifact/q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v3.json'))
assert a['polychord_commit']==b['polychord_commit'], 'POLYCHORD_CROSS_JOB_COMMIT_GATE=FAIL'
assert a['pantheonplus_manifest_sha256']==b['pantheonplus_manifest_sha256'], 'PANTHEONPLUS_CROSS_JOB_HASH_GATE=FAIL'
assert a['cobaya_version']==b['cobaya_version']=='3.5.6'
assert a['pybobyqa_version']==b['pybobyqa_version']=='1.5.0'
print('Q042_CROSS_JOB_SOURCE_IDENTITY_GATE=PASS')
PY

workflow_runs.step: Run bounded FULL PolyChord + external BOBYQA pilot
workflow_runs.run:
python q042_planck_portability_v3.py pilot-cell \
  --q032-parent-root q032_parent \
  --preflight q032_preflight/q032_preflight_sealed_v2.json \
  --parent-dir q032_parent_profiles \
  --hlp-matrix q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.npy \
  --hlp-meta q032_hlp_cov/q032_hillipop_tt3pair_precision_v2.json \
  --reduced-support q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_primary_nonoverlap_support_v3.json \
  --reduced-hlp-matrix q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v3.npy \
  --reduced-hlp-meta q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_hillipop_nonoverlap_precision_v3.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v3.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v3.json \
  --external-runtime q042_runtime/q042_external_runtime_provenance_v3.json \
  --arm ${{ matrix.arm }} \
  --model ${{ matrix.model }} \
  --output-dir q042_pilot_${{ matrix.id }}

python q042_planck_portability_v3.py merge-pilots \
  --input-dir q042_pilots \
  --environment-preflight q042_environment_artifact/q042_environment/q042_runtime_preflight_v3.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v3.json \
  --source-lock q042_planck_portability_source_lock_v3.json \
  --output q042_preflight_final_v3.json
python q042_planck_portability_tests_v3.py final \
  --result q042_preflight_final_v3.json \
  --spec q042_planck_portability_spec_v3.json \
  --output q042_preflight_tests_v3.json

entries.purpose: Retry same-run actions/download-artifact transport failures without changing scientific state.

name.description: Exact artifact name; leave empty when pattern is used.

pattern.description: Artifact pattern; leave empty when name is used.

steps.name: Artifact transport gate
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "$A1" != success && "$A2" != success && "$A3" != success ]]; then
  echo "Q040_SAME_RUN_ARTIFACT_TRANSPORT_GATE=FAIL name=${{ inputs.name }} pattern=${{ inputs.pattern }}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
test -d "${{ inputs.path }}"
if ! find "${{ inputs.path }}" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
  echo "Q040_SAME_RUN_ARTIFACT_CONTENT_GATE=FAIL path=${{ inputs.path }}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "Q040_SAME_RUN_ARTIFACT_TRANSPORT_GATE=PASS name=${{ inputs.name }} pattern=${{ inputs.pattern }}"
